evidence.locator: Agents table; Welcome Bot; What Sidequest installs

evidence.title: Sidequest src-content-docs-docs-guides-agents-and-models-mdx
evidence.locator: Supported agents table; Codex permissions; What only works with Claude; profiles
evidence.finding: Exact launch binaries/flags and feature limitations are documented. Codex defaults to bypassing approvals/sandbox; supervisors run unsandboxed; agents retain their own authentication.

evidence.title: Sidequest src-content-docs-docs-guides-quest-types-mdx
evidence.finding: Worktree quests get branches and separate checkouts, Current Branch quests share the existing directory, and Review quests fetch a PR head into a worktree.

evidence.title: Sidequest src-content-docs-docs-guides-supervisors-mdx
evidence.locator: What a supervisor does; Rules; Starting/stopping; Reporting lines
evidence.finding: Product supervisors can read/send to their own quest group, answer routine prompts and create child work through CLI; the product watcher pulls queue slots. Risky merges/main operations escalate to the user.

evidence.title: Sidequest src-content-docs-docs-advanced-cli-mdx
evidence.locator: quest create/status/read/send; supervisors; Inside a supervisor session lines 284-302
evidence.finding: Product-owned CLI talks to local app socket, creates/activates tasks and supervises live terminals. Supervisor scope limits creation/messages to its own group, and refuses management of unrelated supervisors.

evidence.title: Sidequest src-content-docs-docs-advanced-remote-machines-mdx
evidence.finding: Named remote templates support SSH, one Docker container per quest, devpod or Coder workspaces. The target must have git/tmux/logged-in coding CLI; stock Docker preset needs a suitable image.

evidence.title: Sidequest src-content-docs-docs-reference-faq-mdx
evidence.locator: Does anything leave; data stored; worktrees; completed quests; supervisor permissions
evidence.finding: Docs say no accounts or telemetry and describe local SQLite state, retained worktrees/tmux sessions and configurable completed-quest retention. Supervisor command scope is explicitly not a sandbox.

evidence.title: Sidequest src-content-docs-docs-guides-github-mdx
evidence.locator: Opening paragraph; Issues browser; Review quests; Opening PRs
evidence.finding: GitHub integration uses gh, imports issue prompts and shows PR state. It explicitly never creates or merges PRs itself; an agent runs gh pr create on request.

evidence.title: Sidequest src-content-docs-docs-guides-sagas-mdx
evidence.locator: Start triggers; schedules; run inspection; Result
evidence.finding: Product workflow graphs run manually, on schedules or new PR/issues. Schedules are checked once a minute in the app; missed schedules run once after close/sleep and overlapping scheduled runs are passed over. Agents can report structured Saga results.

evidence.finding: The docs precisely describe a quest Changes panel with actual unified/side-by-side/hunk code, line comments and find. No populated diff screenshot or public implementation for its renderer was established in this pass.
